feed.title: DYAI — Design Your Augmented Intelligence
feed.subtitle: Five movements on what is actually happening.

entry.title: We called it artificial because we did not know where to put it
entry.summary: Nothing about it is artificial. And nothing about it is only intelligence.

entry.title: You were never the only intelligence in the room
entry.summary: You have always been a participant in intelligence you did not own.

entry.title: Two comfortable answers
entry.summary: “It will pass.” — “It will solve everything.” Both are ways of not looking.

entry.title: Everyone wants the capability
entry.summary: Almost nobody wants to pay the price. The price is letting go.

entry.title: Going on was always the plan
entry.summary: Humanity never meant that things stay as they are.
